name: Scanning electron microscopy
summary: Sweeping a fine electron beam across a specimen and collecting the electrons it gives off produces detailed surface images; a Cambridge instrument was used here on paper fibres.
description: A scanned focused electron probe and detected emitted-electron signal map surface structures of specimens.

impact.note: Gave scientists and industry a new way to see surfaces in fine detail; used across many laboratories, with a line of surface analysis built on it.
